description: cua-lite preprocessed version of Aguvis (xlangai/aguvis-stage1 + xlangai/aguvis-stage2). A large-scale composite GUI dataset using a unified PyAutoGUI action format across mobile / browser / desktop. Stage 1 → grounding.action (single-step locate-and-click across SeeClick, GUIEnv, WebUI, RicoSCA, RICO Icon, Widget Captioning, UI RefExp, OmniACT); Stage 2 → use (multi-step trajectories from AndroidControl, AitW, MiniWoB++, COAT, GUIDE).
extra_notes: Sub-datasets already processed from their original sources are excluded here: GUIAct, AMEX (ui_genie), Multimodal-Mind2Web, GUI-Odyssey. Source coordinates are normalized [0,1] → scaled to [0,1000].
